P.name: Whisper
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Death In 4 Acts:}} '''Jhin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} consume [[ammunition]] within 4 rounds. He will reload over {{fd|2.5}} seconds immediately after expending all rounds or withholding leftover rounds after 10 seconds of being [[out of combat]] and not being affected by {{tip|crowd control}}. The latter reload can be interrupted by declaring an attack or casting an ability. '''Jhin''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks during the reload time.
P.description2: '''Jhin's''' final round attack has an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, always {{tip|critically strike|critically strikes}}, including against {{tip|turrets|structures}}, and deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|15 to 25 for 3|1 to 11}} of the target's {{sti|'''missing''' health}}}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 800 against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Every Moment Matters:}} '''Jhin''' gains {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|4;5;6;7;8;9;10;11;12;14;16;20;24;28;32;36;40;44|formula = 4% at + 1% per level up to 9, then + 2% up to 11, then + 4%, capped at level 18}}|attack damage}}<!--stops at 18-->{{ft|{{as|(+ {{fd|0.35}}% per 1% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.3}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}|{{as|(+ 35% critical strike chance)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}{{as|AD}}.
P.description4: Additionally, {{tip|critical strikes}} against enemies grant '''Jhin''' {{as|14%|movement speed}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.44}}% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.

Q.name: Dancing Grenade
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' throws a grenade at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and can bounce to up to three additional nearby enemies, prioritizing the closest enemy that has not been hit.
Q.description2: The grenade's damage is increased by 35% any time an enemy dies by any means after being hit by the grenade before it strikes its next target.

W.name: Deadly Flourish
W.description: {{Anchor|Caught Out}}{{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} that trigger a ''{{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin|Lotus Trap}}'' to bloom or are damaged by '''Jhin''' or allied champions are ''marked'' for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70*0.75 to 210*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|37.5}}% AD)}}}}
W.description3: Hitting a ''marked'' champion {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' {{ais|Whisper|Jhin|Every Moment Matters}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.

W.name: Caught Out
W.description: {{Anchor|Caught Out}}{{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} that trigger a ''{{ai|Captive Audience|Jhin|Lotus Trap}}'' to bloom or are damaged by '''Jhin''' or allied champions are ''marked'' for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies in a line until colliding with an enemy champion, reduced by 25% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 50% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70*0.75 to 210*0.75}} {{as|(+ {{fd|37.5}}% AD)}}}}
W.description3: Hitting a ''marked'' champion {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration and grants '''Jhin''' {{ais|Whisper|Jhin|Every Moment Matters}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}}.

E.name: Captive Audience
E.description: {{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Whenever '''Jhin''' kills an enemy champion, he summons a ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' on their corpse.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' places a ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location which, upon landing, becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 4 seconds.
E.description3: '''Jhin''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Lotus Trap'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description4: ''Blooming Lotus Traps'' {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies. ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} as well as against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.
E.description5: ''See [[Jhin#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Lotus Traps.''

R.name: Curtain Call
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} After {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time, '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health.}}}}. The bullet stops upon hitting an enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of 1 second.
R.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64 to 192}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|64*4 to 192*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*4}}% AD)}}}}
R.description3: The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
R.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|64*2 to 192*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*2}}% AD)}}|Maximum Fourth Shot Damage|{{ap|(64*2)*4 to (192*2)*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(25*2)*4}}% AD)}}}}
